epoch_scaling.decision: seed-0 ablation only: 3 epochs has the best raw NLL (0.874) and ECE (0.048) at seed 0; 5 epochs buys +0.014 accuracy but needs a 1.95 temperature. The 3-epoch multi-seed mean is 0.667 +/- 0.053, so do not compare the 5-epoch single run directly to it; a 5-epoch seed sweep is not yet measured.

vs_baselines_same_test_split.verdict: trained model beats every baseline on accuracy and NLL, and exceeds zero-shot full-model generation (0.52) while emitting zero tokens per decision
